name: lidar stress — Zagreb Cathedral scan003 (Riegl VZ-400, Osnabrueck 3Dscans)
comment: ONE rung at a time: leave a single entry in 'items' and move the others into 'ladder'. Editing this file needs no rebuild, only a page reload. Rungs: lidar_100k.pb 3 MB / lidar_1m.pb 31 MB / lidar_5m.pb 144 MB / lidar_14m.pb 431 MB (13,793,783 points, the full scan). Points are coloured by scanner reflectance (p2..p98 stretch, -15.7..-0.2 dB) and drawn at 3 px. Source units are mm; the scan spans about 72 x 55 x 73 m, so 'at' is [0,0,0] and the camera fit handles the rest.
